content.text:
I changed it so pressing down on a piece that is already resting on the stack restarts its lock delay, the same way left or right does. Both share the existing limit of 3 restarts per piece. I didn't run any checks.

Why: a soft drop that can't move did nothing, so the piece locked on the next gravity step. Sharing the limit keeps the locking rule's cap, so holding down can't stall a piece forever.

Rejected: a separate restart limit for soft drop (it would double the stalling), and adding lock ticks or points when the drop can't move.
